instruction: With repository read access, fetch reachable_branch, git archive repository_base, apply portable-model.patch with patch -p1, verify source/postimages.json. rebuild_model.py automates these steps; it does not fetch historical_local_head.
rebuild_qualification: GCC plus libstdc++; archive host GCC 11.4.0, Ubuntu22.04.5. Other hosts require case qualification; compiler/library differences may change cycles.
